cases.prompt: A cycles result labels an edge static-import. Prevent a runtime-cycle claim when the exact edge is import type.
cases.referenceSolution: Treat static-import as syntactic; exact-read it because it may be type-only.

cases.prompt: A source-root dead-code scan cannot see tests and consumers outside that root.
cases.referenceSolution: Search tests and consumers outside the scanned graph root before a dead-code verdict.

cases.prompt: A reachable file can still contain an unused export; file reachability is not symbol liveness.
cases.referenceSolution: File reachability does not prove export or symbol liveness; verify the symbol separately.

cases.prompt: A file unreachable from index.ts may be a package subpath or alternate entrypoint.
cases.referenceSolution: Check the package manifest and exports for a subpath entrypoint before calling the file unreachable.

cases.prompt: A barrel-only export with no internal callers may still be an external contract or deep import.
cases.referenceSolution: A barrel re-export may be a public or deep import contract; external consumers must be checked.

cases.prompt: Assertions pass but the command exits non-zero because coverage fails.
cases.referenceSolution: The process exit code controls green: a non-zero coverage failure is not a passing verification.
